# RouteVN

> RouteVN is a platform dedicated to visual novels. RouteVN Creator is a free, open-source desktop app for creating visual novels without coding, with tools for scenes, characters, audio, animations, layouts, and exports.

## RouteVN Creator

- [Creator overview](https://routevn.com/en/creator/about/): capabilities, export support, limitations, and FAQ
- [Docs index (LLM-friendly)](https://routevn.com/en/creator/docs/llms.md): machine-readable index of all Creator guides and reference pages
- [Quickstart](https://routevn.com/en/creator/docs/quickstart.md): install RouteVN Creator and build a first project
- [Download](https://routevn.com/en/creator/download/): get RouteVN Creator for Windows, macOS, and Linux
- [Changelog](https://routevn.com/en/creator/changelog/): release history for RouteVN Creator

## Why RouteVN

- [RouteVN vs Ren'Py](https://routevn.com/en/blog/routevn-vs-renpy.md): comparison covering workflow, code vs no-code, customization, exports, docs, and community

## Optional

- [Blog](https://routevn.com/en/blog/): devlogs, creator interviews, and announcements
- [Asset Store](https://routevn.com/en/creator/asset-store/): assets for building visual novels
